Name: (CP) Wraith Butterfly Trinket
Author: xtobefreex
Description:
[u][b]OVERVIEW:[/b][/u]
This mod is a retexture for the fairy trinket that you unlock and have a chance to find after reaching the weapons mastery. 

The mod uses the winter glow butterfly sprites that are already in the game, but they are recoloured and with lower transparency to give a more ethereal feel to them.

[center][size=4][b][u]
VERSION 2.0.0 HAS RELEASED![/u][/b]
[/size]﻿

I've added a toggle between an altered winter glow butterfly and my own glowing butterfly texture. This can be toggled within the GMCM in game or in the config file that is created after loading the game. The default sprite is the one that I created, but I've kept the original for those who may like it better.



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29775/29775-1742441867-1893175995.gif[/img] [b][u]
[/u][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29775/29775-1742441867-1457678890.gif[/img]﻿﻿


[u]An optional file called [b]Wraith Butterfly Trinket Standalone [/b]has been included.[/u] This allows the game to drop a trinket called the Crystal Ring, which will then spawn the wraith butterflies when equipped. The butterflies glow and heal like the fairies do. This mod has a toggle that toggles between the fairies being shown and the wraith butterflies being shown, as the wraith butterflies will replace the fairies. I couldn't figure that one out for the life of me, sorry guys. And please let me know if you run into any issues!

[u][img]https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:bojdpdviokjhfedou2msqhkk/bafkreieycgzwwq7bdplv5mhrspk45qyfbsqs7ekvprlaxzs2fsbwgkrjy4@jpeg[/img][/u]
[b]
[u]Only have one version of the Wraith Butterfly Trinket installed at a time! Either download the main file, or the optional file.[/u][/b][/center]

[u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]
1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is not required but is recommended.
2. Unzip the folder into[font=Courier New] Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
3. Run the game through the SMAPI launcher.

[u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is intended for Stardew Valley version 1.6 or later versions. 
[*]This mod has been tested in single-player and works perfectly fine; multiplayer has not been tested but [i]should[/i] work. Please make sure all players have the mod to prevent possible errors.
[*]If you have any mods that retexture the fairy trinket, there will be conflicts. Please only use one fairy trinket retexture mod.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: The main version of this mod. Download the optional version instead of this one if you want a Crystal Ring trinket! This one only replaces the fairies with the fairy box trinket.
